visual.general_description: Nine-row series of OCT and fundus autofluorescence images, panels A to I, of both eyes.
visual.detailed_description: Each row has four image tiles: an OCT cross-section at the far left, two grayscale autofluorescence fundus images in the middle, and an OCT cross-section at the far right. The panel letter is printed in white at the left edge of the row. Row A has red arrows on both OCT scans and white arrows on both fundus images. In rows B to I, no arrows are shown; a crescent-shaped dark area with a bright rim becomes visible lower-left of the fovea on the left-hand fundus image from about panel C or D onward and appears larger in the later rows, while the right-hand fundus image shows only a small faint change in later rows.

panels.general_description: Four-tile OCT and fundus autofluorescence panel A.
panels.detailed_description: Each row has four image tiles: an OCT cross-section at the far left, two grayscale autofluorescence fundus images in the middle, and an OCT cross-section at the far right. The panel letter is printed in white at the left edge of the row. Red arrows point up at the outer retinal bands beside the foveal depression on both OCT scans, left of it on the left scan and right of it on the right scan; white arrows point at a brighter patch lower-left of the dark foveal spot on the left-hand fundus image and at a faint bright area lower-right of the fovea on the right-hand fundus image. The OCT scans show layered retinal bands in a horizontal cross-section with the foveal contour near the center.

visual.general_description: Two panels, A and B, each with right-eye and left-eye Humphrey 10-2 SITA-Fast visual field reports.

panels.general_description: Humphrey 10-2 SITA-Fast visual field printouts for the right eye and the left eye, panel A.
panels.detailed_description: Two printed reports side by side, each headed in red RIGHT EYE HFA (left report) and LEFT EYE HFA (right report) with Humphrey 10-2 SITA-Fast, fixation target central, stimulus III white. Each report shows a grayscale map with a 10-degree axis, a numeric threshold grid, and Total Deviation and Pattern Deviation numeric grids with probability symbol maps and a P-value legend. Printed statistics, right eye: fixation losses 1/11, false positive errors 16%, false negative errors 9%, test duration 03:57, MD -3.52 dB P < 1%, PSD 2.52 dB P < 1%. Left eye: fixation losses 3/11, false positive errors 37%, false negative errors 17%, test duration 04:16, MD -3.33 dB P < 1%, PSD 4.64 dB P < 1%. Right-eye grayscale map: mostly light with a tiny mark near the center-right; many Total Deviation probability symbols are shaded in the central field. Left-eye grayscale map: a dark blotch right of center in the upper half; Total and Pattern Deviation maps show shaded probability symbols in the central field.

Each report shows a grayscale map with a 10-degree axis, a numeric threshold grid, and Total Deviation and Pattern Deviation numeric grids with probability symbol maps and a P-value legend. Printed statistics, right eye: fixation losses 2/13, false positive errors 13%, false negative errors 6%, test duration 04:59, MD -2.45 dB P < 2%, PSD 3.61 dB P < 1%. Left eye: fixation losses 2/13, false positive errors 7%, false negative errors 0%, test duration 05:26, MD -2.24 dB P < 5%, PSD 6.12 dB P < 1%. Right-eye grayscale map: a dark focal spot in the upper-left quadrant; deviation maps show scattered shaded symbols. Left-eye grayscale map: a curved dark band in the upper-right quadrant; Pattern and Total Deviation maps show many shaded symbols across the lower and central field.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Printed Humphrey perimetry reports with grayscale map and deviation plots
